references.text: The context that introduces God's plagues and diseases upon the disobedient, including Egypt's diseases
The Lord will set him apart for disaster with all the curses of the law written in this book
God promises not to lay any of Egypt's diseases on Israel if they obey Him
The Lord promises to remove disease from Israel if they serve Him
The Lord will keep all disease away from Israel and not lay any of Egypt's evil diseases upon them
The Lord will strike with consumption, fever, inflammation, and other diseases
The Lord will strike with the boils of Egypt, swellings, scabs, and itching
The Lord will strike with painful sores on the knees and thighs
